A. $0$
B. $1$
C. $2$

5: Compute the limit $\lim_{n\to\infty}\dfrac{(3n+2)^2-(1-2n)^2}{(2n-1)^2}$. In the boxes below enter, from left to right, the units digit and the first two decimal digits of the resulting finite decimal expansion.
9: From the set of all four-digit natural numbers, one number is drawn. Compute the probability of the event that the drawn number is divisible by $15$, given that it is divisible by $18$.
10: The line passing through points $A=(8,-6)$ and $B=(5,15)$ is tangent to a circle centered at point $O=(0,0)$. Find the radius of this circle and the coordinates of the point of tangency of this circle with line $AB$.
12: Solve the equation $\cos 2x=\dfrac{\sqrt2}{2}(\cos x-\sin x)$ in the interval $[0,\pi]$.
13: A right triangle $ABC$ is given. The radius of the circle inscribed in this triangle is five times shorter than the hypotenuse of this triangle. Find the sine of the acute angle of triangle $ABC$ that has the greater measure.
15: A certain plant received an order to build a rectangular cuboid tank (completely open at the top) with a capacity of $144\text{ m}^3$. The base of the tank is to be a square. None of the dimensions (edges of the cuboid) may exceed $9$ meters. The total cost of construction was set as follows: $100$ PLN per $1\text{ m}^2$ of the base, $75$ PLN per $1\text{ m}^2$ of a side wall. Find the dimensions of the tank for which the cost of construction, set this way, is smallest.
